## Remarks

Called by `migrate:rollback` and `migrate:reset`<!-- -->. Should be safe to run against a database where `up` only partly succeeded, so prefer [Schema.dropIfExists()](./database.schema.dropifexists.md) over [Schema.drop()](./database.schema.drop.md)<!-- -->.
